newsitem.title: REPUBLIC OF IRELAND: Ireland, China conclude air transport agreement.
newsitem.headline: Ireland, China conclude air transport agreement.

text.p: Ireland said on Wednesday it had concluded a bilateral air transport agreement giving Irish airlines access to Beijing and Shenzhen and Chinese airlines access to Dublin and Shannon.
The department of transport said both countries had also agreed to promote closer relations in the air transport field.
"While scheduled passenger air services between China and Ireland are not likely in the short term, the agreement provides the framework for such services in the future," it said in a statement.

"Of immediate benefit to the Irish aviation industry is the fact that the negotiation of the agreement facilitates the further development of commercial co-operation between Irish and Chinese aviation and aerospace companies."
